feature_contract.goal: Preserve original +TIME banner and numeric glyph ownership across direct original E8, native SpriteNode, and deferred D3DX GPU submission; refuse VR mode-toggled or reentrant queued source as a new binocular HUD owner.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only two original +TIME sprani parents and three numeric parents. Do not alter mode-2 0x98AC6, GOAL B9200, SkyGlow, game timer, native input/FFB, R26_SAFE or DXVK.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: A stable source VR admission publishes +TIME sprite queue siblings and direct numeric draw ownership; VR toggle during CALL never publishes desktop nodes as VR HUD.
VR off->on, on->off, in-queue reentry refuse source admission, preserve original D3DX fallback and owner restoration.
Full DX9Ex Active, Domain, EXE HUD Inspector and Full Source Impact on one exact SHA; HMD optics separate.

diagnosis.original_evidence: StageExtensionEnter made the direct owner conditional on VREnabled but StageExtensionLeave unconditionally called TagAppendedNodes under ScreenHud, including sources entered with VR disabled.
diagnosis.root_cause: Producer entry conditions were not retained across the original 0x989xx CALL. A VR toggle could leave desktop or reentrant queued +TIME SpriteNodes with an unsupported binocular ScreenHud owner.
alternatives_rejected: Do not add the mode-2 0x98AC6 unrelated animation
Do not globally promote generic glyphs or flush unrelated D3DX batches
Do not assert Quest3 +TIME optics PASS without HMD execution.
